closure_boundary: The former indirect GPU escape is closed for the canonical executable: all compiled DXBC BLENDINDICES input signatures have ReadWriteMask=0xE and embedded HLSL has no X reference, while provenance-confirmed CPU consumers also do not read X. Therefore canonical runtime non-use of lane X is EXE_CONFIRMED. The serialized byte is still preserved and intentionally not renamed padding/reserved because ABI compatibility with non-canonical data is a separate question.
